subject: Dedicated reservation: anchor minimum, phased activation sprint & contingency
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lucidcove.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated reservation proposal — anchor min + phased activation sprint

Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is a short proposal that maps LucidCove's traffic profile to three viable reservation structures so your procurement and infra teams can compare cost predictability vs flexibility. High-level summary here so it's easy to skim: 

1) Anchor-min (lowest-cost predictable)
   - Cluster: 32 x A100 equivalent GPUs (single-region)
   - Anchor/minimum guarantee: 20 GPUs always available (soft floor)
   - Activation sprint: 6-week phased activation to the full 32 GPUs (see milestones below)
   - Use case fit: steady inference with occasional bursts; best unit cost

2) Staged-tranche (balanced predictability + elasticity)
   - Cluster: 48 x A100 equivalent GPUs (multi-zone)
   - Anchor/minimum guarantee: 28 GPUs
   - Warm-up tranche: first 8 GPUs available day 1; remaining tranches unlocked every 2 weeks
   - Burst: pay-as-you-go burst pool (on top of tranche pricing)

3) Flex-burst (elastic, lower upfront commitment)
   - Cluster: 64 x equivalent capacity provisioned but only 12 GPUs committed as min guarantee;
   - Burst pool accessible at market rates for peak windows;
   - Use case fit: unpredictable spikes, early-stage models with traffic variability

Activation sprint milestones (Anchor-min example):
   Week 0: Contract signed + PO received
   Week 1: Provision 20-anchor GPUs, network prep and model onboarding begins
   Week 2-3: Prefix/KV cache seeding and 8 GPU tranche live (canary customers)
   Week 4: 4 GPU top-up (automated scaling tests)
   Week 6: Full 32 GPU cluster live, SLA baseline run

Contingency & rollback: 14-day decommit window on tranches 2/3; automated fallback to compatible, quantized model variant if peak capacity constrained. We include 100 GPU-hours of warmup credits in the Anchor-min offer to accelerate cold-starts.

Attached: LucidCove_Dedicated_Offer_v3.pdf (detailed pricing, SLA language) and warmup-credit-schedule.xlsx.

Next steps I propose:
  - You confirm preferred structure (1/2/3) by EOD Friday
  - Redwood prepares SOW & DocuSign package for your procurement
  - We schedule a 30-min runbook review with your infra team (model owners + network)

Happy to walk through numbers tomorrow — looping Grace and Priyom for bandwidth on the onboarding timeline.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: LucidCove_Dedicated_Offer_v3.pdf]

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lucidcove.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Mills <tmills@lucidcove.ai>, LucidCove Sales <sales@lucidcove.ai>
Date: 2026-10-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated reservation proposal — anchor min + phased activation sprint

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary and the deck. A few clarifications from our CTO and procurement: 

- Our traffic shows a steady baseline with predictable morning/evening peaks. The Anchor-min option looks closest to what we want.
- Procurement asked whether the 14-day decommit applies to the anchor (20 GPUs) or only to subsequent tranches. They prefer a shorter notice window for the anchor if costs are lower.
- We also need to confirm how warmup credits apply across environments (staging vs prod). Are credits per-cluster or pooled at account level?

On timeline: LucidCove is aiming to have production capacity by Dec 15 — procurement timelines are tight, so the SOW needs to be in the hands of our legal + finance by Oct 30. Can you confirm Redwood can meet that?

Also copying Trevor (procurement) to own the PO side.

Samira
Head of Platform | LucidCove AI
[Attachment: internal-traffic-profile.csv]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lucidcove.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Trevor Mills <tmills@lucidcove.ai>
Date: 2026-10-24T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated reservation proposal — anchor min + phased activation sprint

Samira / Trevor —

Appreciate the quick review. Answers inline: 

- 14-day decommit: applies only to tranche top-ups (tranches 2/3). The Anchor (20 GPUs) is a firm minimum with a 30-day notice for decommit to protect capacity planning across our fleet. However, we can offer a limited pilot reduction (up to 2 GPUs) with 7-day notice during the first 8 weeks if you'd like a safety valve while you ramp.

- Warmup credits: pooled at the account level. The 100 GPU-hours included in Anchor-min can be applied across staging and prod, but we recommend reserving at least 25% for production cold-cache events. The attached warmup-credit-schedule.xlsx shows suggested allocation and a plan for incremental credits during the 6-week sprint.

- Timing: We can hit Dec 15 if DocuSign is signed and PO is issued by Oct 30. Redwood will target the following internal milestones to make that happen: 
   - Oct 26: SOW + T&Cs ready and shared via DocuSign (we'll include the 30-day anchor decommit clause and the 7-day pilot reduction option)
   - Oct 28: Final negotiation window complete
   - Oct 30: SOW signed and PO received by Redwood finance
   - Nov 2 - Nov 13: Infra prep, model onboarding & prewarm (first tranche live Nov 9)
   - Dec 15: Full production ramp (per the 6-week sprint)

Pricing note (anchor-min example):
   - Anchor GPUs (20): $X.XX / GPU-hour (committed-rate, 12-month term)
   - Tranche top-ups: discounted committed rate for any GPUs added within first 3 months
   - Burst pool: market rate hourly for on-demand capacity

Priyom and Grace — can you prepare a 1-page SOW template that encodes the 30-day anchor decommit, 7-day pilot reduction, warmup credit pool, and the sprint milestones? We want to avoid a long back-and-forth with LucidCove legal.

Trevor — please confirm the PO contact and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly). If monthly, we'll add an invoice template to the DocuSign packet.

Thanks — I'll push the DocuSign package by COB Oct 26.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: warmup-credit-schedule.xlsx]

From: Trevor Mills <tmills@lucidcove.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@lucidcove.ai>
Cc: LucidCove Sales <sales@lucidcove.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated reservation proposal — anchor min + phased activation sprint

Rishi / Team —

Confirmed from procurement: monthly billing cadence is preferred. PO contact is myself (I'll route to AP). We'll aim to issue PO within 48 hours of DocuSign completion. A couple of asks before we sign: 

1) Please include a short appendix listing IP/data residency commitments (we operate EU customers and want to confirm no cross-border retention outside selected regions).
2) Can you add an explicit SLA baseline for 99.5% availability for the anchor GPUs once full activation is complete? We understand higher SLAs may have cost impact — flag any delta.

If those two items are in the SOW, I expect legal and AP to sign quickly. Thanks for accommodating the 30-day anchor protection and the 7-day pilot reduction — that helps our internal risk case.

Trevor
Head of Procurement | LucidCove AI
